name: revenue-manager
description: Hardened STR revenue management skill. Required core: one PMS (Hospitable, Guesty, OwnerRez, Hostaway, Lodgify, Uplisting, Smoobu, Hostfully) plus a pricing tool (PriceLabs or Beyond). Optionally uses RankBreeze or IntelliHost for ranking, AirROI for named comps, and Turno/Breezeway for ops, all read-only. Uses the live PMS calendar as ground truth, uses the operator-stated per-channel markup (never inferred), and tracks both ask and cleared (ADR) rates. Every recommendation runs through a safety layer (per-listing floor/ceiling, 15% max-delta, thin-comp transparency, currency gate, explanatory confidence, freshness), walks the Revenue Flywheel on every call, and changes prices only on a plain yes, through a safe writer that plans, applies, re-reads and can roll back. Logs every approved change to Supabase audit tables.
